summary: Mutually exclusive choices shown all at once: picking one clears the others, and the group is the form field (Web Components).

name.note: Form field name. The group submits the selected item's value under it.

value.note: Value of the selected item; null when none is selected. The initial attribute is the reset value.

required.note: A selection is required: valueMissing while none is selected; aria-required on the radiogroup.

disabled.note: Disables every item; the group is not submitted.

orientation.note: Layout only; every arrow key moves in both orientations, as in a native radio group.

anatomy.name: group
anatomy.notes: div role=radiogroup in the shadow root; named by the host's aria-label.

default.notes: The items. Their order is the arrow-key order.

change.note: Fired once after a person selects an item (click, label, Space or arrow key). Not fired when value is set from code or by form reset.

focus-visible.note: Ring around the focused control (the selected item is the tab stop).

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: Host aria-label is forwarded to the radiogroup; otherwise name it with a visible legend in a sb-field-set. Each item is named by its label.

formAssociation.note: The group is the form field (FormAssociated mixin): name, value, required, disabled. formValue is the selected value or null; form reset restores the initial value attribute; the validity anchor is the first enabled item's native radio, so reportValidity() focuses it. Items are not form-associated: native radios in separate shadow roots cannot form a native group, so the group owns exclusivity, the tab stop and arrow keys.

accessibility.targetSize: The 16px control and its label (a 20px row) form one clickable target; the 12px vertical (24px horizontal) gap between items satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: :focus-visible on the native radio; 3px solid ring in radio-group.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Console warning, once per item (in every build), when the item has no label; and once per group when the group has no aria-label (a name from an outer legend is not detected).

keyboard.Tab: enters the group on the selected item, else the first enabled one; leaves on the next Tab
keyboard.ArrowRight: next item and select it (previous in RTL)
keyboard.ArrowLeft: previous item and select it (next in RTL)
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009)

aria: group: role="radiogroup" with the forwarded aria-label and aria-required when required
items: native input type=radio, each with aria-posinset and aria-setsize so the set reads as N of M although every radio lives in its own shadow root
roving tab stop: one item has tabindex 0, the rest -1; selection follows focus
disabled items are skipped by the arrows and are not focusable

elements.summary: One radio button of a sb-radio-group, with its label. The group owns its checked state.

value.note: Submitted as the group's value when selected.

label.note: Visible label next to the control; names the radio.

disabled.note: Disables this item only; it is skipped by the arrows.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.notes: The <label> row: clicking the label text selects the item.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Native <input type=radio> in the shadow root, a group of one; checked, tab stop and posinset come from the group.

elements.notes: Must be a direct child of sb-radio-group.

A required choice submitted with a form

Radio group for an on/off choice

The radios have no accessible name

drift.contract: native radios, each a group of one, driven by the group
drift.realization: native radios in separate shadow roots cannot share a group; aria-posinset and aria-setsize restore the set size. Chromium's accessibility tree does not report them, so the spec asserts the attributes

drift.contract: aria-required on the radiogroup, group-level valueMissing
drift.realization: the reference implementation sets required on every member radio

openQuestions.question: Native inputs or role=radio buttons for the items?
openQuestions.recommendation: Native input type=radio in each item (native first). Radios in separate shadow roots cannot form a native group, so each is a group of one and the group sets checked, tabindex, aria-posinset and aria-setsize; the accessibility tree then shows a radiogroup of N radios.
openQuestions.answer: Native inputs, driven by the group.

openQuestions.question: Where does form association live?
openQuestions.recommendation: On the group (name, value, required, disabled), like a native radio group is one field. Items are plain elements.
openQuestions.answer: The group is form-associated; items are not.

openQuestions.question: How is required reported?
openQuestions.recommendation: Group-level valueMissing with the browser's own message (read from an unattached required radio), anchored to the first enabled item's radio; aria-required on the radiogroup instead of required on every inner radio.
openQuestions.answer: Group valueMissing; aria-required on the radiogroup.

openQuestions.question: Item label: slot or prop?
openQuestions.recommendation: label prop, as Input and Checkbox have. Rich labels are not needed yet.

openQuestions.question: Invalid styling and an error prop?
openQuestions.recommendation: Out of scope here; Field's sb-field-error carries error text. The browser's validity bubble covers required.
